item.title: Residents Invited to Help Shape Possible Essich Road Masterplan in Inverness
item.description: Residents in Inverness are being invited to help shape a possible Masterplan Consent Area at Essich Road, with further engagement underway as Highland Council explores plans for up to 400 homes alongside green space and supporting infrastructure.The post Residents Invited to Help Shape Possible Essich Road Masterplan in Inverness appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Major Upgrade Announced for Birsay Campsite in Orkney
item.description: Birsay Campsite in Orkney is set for a major upgrade after more than £900,000 in funding was secured, delivering modern facilities, renewable energy, and an extended season to support sustainable tourism and community use across the islands.The post Major Upgrade Announced for Birsay Campsite in Orkney appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Northbound Lane Closure on A82 Near Corran Ferry From 16 February
item.description: A northbound lane closure on the A82 near Corran Ferry will begin on 16 February 2026 as part of infrastructure improvements, with phased daytime works planned through to 24 April to support tree clearing and a new junction.The post Northbound Lane Closure on A82 Near Corran Ferry From 16 February appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: SNP Says Sarwar ‘Can’t Get off The Hook’ Over Mandelson Links
item.description: The SNP has criticised Anas Sarwar over his past association with Peter Mandelson and his position on Keir Starmer, intensifying political tensions ahead of the 7th May vote. The post SNP Says Sarwar ‘Can’t Get off The Hook’ Over Mandelson Links appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Yellow Snow and Ice Warning Issued Across Highlands and Islands
item.description: A yellow snow and ice warning has been issued across the Highlands and Islands from Thursday afternoon through Friday, with travel disruption, icy roads and snow accumulations expected across low ground and higher routes.The post Yellow Snow and Ice Warning Issued Across Highlands and Islands appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Community Wealth Building Bill Passed by Scottish Parliament
item.description: The Community Wealth Building Bill has been passed by the Scottish Parliament, aiming to retain more public investment within local economies and support small businesses, social enterprises and community ownership across Scotland.The post Community Wealth Building Bill Passed by Scottish Parliament appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Major Young Rider Safety Study Launched to Tackle High Casualty Rates
item.description: More than 22,000 young motorcyclists were injured between 2019 and 2023, with nearly a third killed or seriously injured, as new UK research aims to reshape training, communication and safety support for riders aged 16 to 24.The post Major Young Rider Safety Study Launched to Tackle High Casualty Rates appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Orbex to Appoint Administrators After Funding Efforts Fail
item.description: Orbex is set to appoint administrators after failing to secure new investment, putting hundreds of skilled Scottish space sector jobs and planned test launches of its Prime microlauncher at risk.The post Orbex to Appoint Administrators After Funding Efforts Fail appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Munro Hails New £20 Million Rural & Islands Housing Fund
item.description: A proposed £20 million Rural and Island Housing Grant Scheme has been welcomed by SNP candidate Eilidh Munro, with the Scottish Government aiming to support first time buyers and families to remain in Highland and island communities.The post Munro Hails New £20 Million Rural & Islands Housing Fund appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: SNP Demands Publication of Doyle Vetting Documents
item.description: The SNP has written to Keir Starmer demanding publication of vetting documents relating to Matthew Doyle’s appointment to the House of Lords, raising questions over what Downing Street knew prior to the peerage being granted.The post SNP Demands Publication of Doyle Vetting Documents appeared first on The Highland Times.
